paper.title: Reinforced UI Instruction Grounding: Towards a Generic UI Task Automation API
paper.central_claim: A metadata-free screenshot-and-instruction Swin/BART pixel-to-sequence grounder gains spatial grounding accuracy by jointly supervising coordinate-value tokens with bbox IoU policy gradients in addition to token CE, beating same-architecture baselines and contemporary UI grounders and showing potential as a generic UI task automation API.

provenance.unavailable_reason: Actual model is environment self-report; SDK session/receipt IDs not exposed. No model probe performed.
provenance.blindness: Only assigned paper, fixed rules/cards, manifest, calibration protocol, and permitted REQ field were read. No other seat, previous own attempts, other batches, or aggregate ratings were read.
provenance.adjudication_applied: REQ-2310.04716-1: supplementary=A–E complete; omissions not_reported; same-architecture central comparison; inherited MoTIF split; source table-number errors; author-cited originals nonblocking.

sections_read: Appendix B Table6 and Figure3 discussion
materials.reading_note: Read deduplicated body L96–556 incl all appendices; duplicated flattened HTML blocks L78–94 are not additional sections. Figure claims rely on text/captions, not independent inspection of embedded image pixels. Published A–E accepted as supplementary per ruling.

signatures.object: Swin encoder/BART decoder metadata-free grounder vs same-architecture CE-only baseline
signatures.information: Train: screenshots, instructions, target boxes; teacher-forced previous ground-truth tokens. Deploy: screenshot+instruction only; no element enumeration/metadata.
signatures.operation: Initialize from document-text pretrained model; autoregressively serialize bbox coordinates with tagged prompts; optimize CE + equal-weight sampled bbox-IoU PG, shared only over coordinate-value tokens.
signatures.output: Four-coordinate bbox; evaluate its center as click prediction.
signatures.conditions: Accurate instruction-box labels; differentiable log probabilities despite nondifferentiable inverse tokenizer; training/inference conditioning gap remains.
signatures.feedback: Ground-truth bbox IoU (rule-calculated, not learned judge or environment terminal reward).

selection_rule.data: RicoSCA+MoTIF partial training; ~37K Common Crawl images/~0.5M generated pairs for desktop separately
selection_rule.acceptance: Gradient training, not accepted/rejected reusable tools; checkpoint criterion not reported
selection_rule.hyperparameter: MC=64 chosen for training-efficiency tradeoff; independent development split not specified

signatures.persistence: Offline learned model weights; no self-modifying agent memory or ongoing selection loop.
signatures.later_use: Frozen weights infer boxes on later held-out static screenshot-instruction pairs.
signatures.failure_boundary: Single-reference box noise, ambiguity, occlusion; no planning/recovery/typing-content execution shown.

signatures.object: Which output tokens and geometric grouping receive RL credit
signatures.information: Coordinate-token identity and grouped bbox, with supervised template tokens separate.
signatures.operation: Contrast point/vertices/bbox rewards and all-token vs coordinate-only PG.
signatures.output: A geometry-specific reward assignment chosen as RUIG design.
signatures.conditions: Coordinate values jointly determine geometry; template tokens have different semantics.

selection_rule.data: Reported evaluation tables; no separate development set recorded
selection_rule.rule: bbox coordinate-only design selected by reported experiments

signatures.persistence: Static training objective/mask in trained model, not per-task retained edits.
signatures.later_use: Same objective for subsequent training runs and 12-layer replication.
signatures.failure_boundary: No gradient-distribution proof; no independent validation of hyperparameter selection.

gap.author_gap: Metadata-dependent executors constrain generic UI automation; ordinary token-wise CE does not explicitly optimize combined coordinate geometry.
gap.checked_gap: Source supports concrete inference-permission limitation and a CE/IoU objective mismatch; does not prove autoregressive models cannot learn geometry or establish novel RL machinery.
